summary: The colorful loot-driven action RPG series from Runic Games and later Echtra/XD, spanning single-player dungeon crawlers, console ports, Torchlight III, and the cross-platform live-service Torchlight: Infinite.

entries.title: Torchlight

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than Xbox 360 emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with modding/compatibility options.

primary.why: Windows is the original release and best fidelity/capture/modding route; Mac, Linux, and Xbox 360 have no documented exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG or another current storefront, applying compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or platform-exclusive story edition is documented.

entries.title: Torchlight II
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release, plus optional console-pet checks

emulation.notes: Use native PC for the full run.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with mods and PC multiplayer options.

primary.why: Windows offers the best fidelity, modding, and multiplayer flexibility, while the console versions only add small exclusive pet bonuses.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG/Humble; optionally sample the console ports only to document their exclusive pets.

secondary.what_to_play: Check or record the Switch-exclusive pet; no full replay needed.
secondary.why: The official Torchlight II site says each console version has its own exclusive pet.

secondary.what_to_play: Check or record the PS4-exclusive pet; no full replay needed.
secondary.why: The official Torchlight II site says each console version has its own exclusive pet.

secondary.what_to_play: Check or record the Xbox One-exclusive pet; no full replay needed.
secondary.why: The official Torchlight II site says each console version has its own exclusive pet.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console ports trade away PC modding/large-session flexibility but add exclusive pets.

entries.title: Torchlight III

primary.why: Windows is the best capture route and no console-exclusive story content is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam or another current storefront; check settings and online/multiplayer behavior notes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Originally planned as Torchlight Frontiers before becoming Torchlight III; no remaster or exclusive-content edition is documented.

entries.title: Torchlight: Infinite

emulation.notes: Use the native PC client instead of mobile capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output, subject to live-service client settings.

primary.why: Torchlight: Infinite is cross-platform across Windows, Android, and iOS; Windows is the best capture route for the live-service ARPG.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC client through Steam or the official client with the required account binding; verify current season/server status before streaming.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service game; seasonal content and monetization can change, so verify current status before streaming.
